apps.name: GPSLogger
apps.description: logs GPS information to various formats (GPX, KML, CSV, NMEA, Custom URL) and has options for uploading (SFTP, OpenStreetMap, Google Drive, Dropbox, Email). This app aims to be as battery efficient as possible.

apps.name: GPXSee
apps.description: GPXSee is a Qt-based GPS log file viewer and analyzer that supports all common GPS log file formats.

apps.name: Organic Maps
apps.description: A free Android & iOS offline maps app for travelers, tourists, hikers, and cyclists. It uses crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data. No ads, no tracking, no data collection, no crapware.

apps.name: OsmAnd
apps.description: This project aims at providing comfortable map viewing and navigation (routing) application for mobile devices. Particular stress lies with complete offline features (via pre-loaded offline map data) or economic internet usage.

apps.name: Positional
apps.description: A very flexible and customizable location related information app. It utilises the phone's GPS hardware and fetches various details of the current latitude and longitude data like Altitude, Speed, Address and similar other information and show it in easily understandable format.

apps.name: Street Complete
apps.description: An easy to use editor of OpenStreetMap data available for Android. It can be used without any OpenStreetMap-specific knowledge. It asks simple questions, with answers directly used to edit and improve OpenStreetMap data. The app is aimed at users who do not know anything about OSM tagging schemes but still want to contribute to OpenStreetMap.

apps.name: Transportr
apps.description: The public transport companion that respects your privacy and your freedom. Transportr is a non-profit app developed by people around the world to make using public transport as easy as possible wherever you are. This app uses the data of various local public transport agencies and provides a unified interface for them.

apps.name: c:geo
apps.description: A full-featured, open-source client for geocaching and other geocaching platforms.

apps.name: CycleStreets
apps.description: A UK-wide cycle journey planner designed by cyclists, for cyclists.

apps.name: ForestMate
apps.description: A hiking safety companion using forest public data: risk prediction, offline fallback, one-tap SOS, and a Wear OS companion.

apps.name: Mapbox Dev Preview
apps.description: A developer preview app showcasing the features of the Mapbox Maps SDK for Android.

apps.name: Maps.me
apps.description: An offline map application based on OpenStreetMap data.

apps.name: NextGIS Mobile
apps.description: A full-featured GIS application for creating and editing map data on the go.

apps.name: Opaler
apps.description: A public transport card manager for the Opal card system in Sydney, Australia.

apps.name: OpenBikeSharing
apps.description: An app to check the availability of shared bikes in your city.

apps.name: PAT Track
apps.description: A real-time bus tracker for the Port Authority of Allegheny County in Pittsburgh, PA.

apps.name: Picoroid
apps.description: An app that shows Panoramio images around the user's current location. (Archived)

apps.name: RoX for Android
apps.description: An Android application for tourism recommendations.

apps.name: SeeWeather
apps.description: A weather app built with RxJava, Retrofit, and Material Design.

apps.name: TICE
apps.description: A secure, real-time location sharing app for meeting up with friends and family.

apps.name: Travel Mate
apps.description: An app designed to be a complete travel guide for your trips. (Archived)
